name: to-human
description: Read a session as a report, not a transcript: under the to-human output style the session sends you messages through its message tool (mcp__to-human__message), the terminal folds its working record (tool calls, scratch notes, other sessions' messages) behind buttons, each message raises a notification, and what you must read closely goes on the session's panel (mcp__to-human__present), a page a fork of the session writes in the background
